name: Xero
label: Xero — Xero Accounting API 2.0
description: Official Xero Accounting API 2.0. Docs: https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/overview. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Expense Claims / Receipts / Employees decommissioned 2026-04-28 — omitted. Partner review required for Custom Connections.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Xero. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: contact_create | contact_get | contact_list | contact_update | invoice_create | invoice_get | invoice_list | invoice_update | payment_create | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Name` for operations: contact_create, contact_update.

schema.label: EmailAddress
schema.description: Request-body parameter `EmailAddress` for operation: contact_create.

schema.label: ContactID
schema.description: URL path/request-body parameter `ContactID` for operations: contact_get, contact_update. Required by: contact_get.

schema.label: where
schema.description: Query-string parameter `where` for operations: contact_list, invoice_list.

schema.label: order
schema.description: Query-string parameter `order` for operation: contact_list.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: contact_list, invoice_list.

schema.label: Type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Type` for operation: invoice_create.

schema.label: Contact
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Contact` for operation: invoice_create.

schema.label: LineItems
schema.description: Request-body parameter `LineItems` for operation: invoice_create.

schema.label: InvoiceID
schema.description: URL path/request-body parameter `InvoiceID` for operations: invoice_get, invoice_update. Required by: invoice_get.

schema.label: Statuses
schema.description: Query-string parameter `Statuses` for operation: invoice_list.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Status` for operation: invoice_update.

schema.label: Invoice
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Invoice` for operation: payment_create.

schema.label: Account
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Account` for operation: payment_create.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Amount` for operation: payment_create.

schema.label: Date
schema.description: Invoice or payment date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create/update, payment_create. Example: 2026-01-15. https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/invoices

schema.label: DueDate
schema.description: Invoice due date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create/update. Example: 2026-02-14.

schema.label: LineAmountTypes
schema.description: invoice_create. EXACT: Exclusive | Inclusive | NoTax. Example: Exclusive.

schema.label: InvoiceNumber
schema.description: Invoice number. invoice_create. Example: INV-0100.

schema.label: Reference
schema.description: Invoice or payment reference. invoice_create / payment_create.

schema.label: CurrencyCode
schema.description: ISO 4217 currency. invoice_create. Example: USD.

schema.label: FirstName
schema.description: Contact first name. contact_create. Example: Ada.

schema.label: LastName
schema.description: Contact last name. contact_create. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: Phones
schema.description: Contact phones [{PhoneType, PhoneNumber}]. contact_create. PhoneType: DEFAULT | DDI | MOBILE | FAX.

schema.label: Addresses
schema.description: Contact addresses [{AddressType, AddressLine1, City, PostalCode, Country}]. AddressType: POBOX | STREET.

schema.label: IsCustomer
schema.description: Mark contact as a customer. contact_create.

schema.label: IsSupplier
schema.description: Mark contact as a supplier. contact_create.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: contact_create | contact_get | contact_list | contact_update | invoice_create | invoice_get | invoice_list | invoice_update | payment_create | trigger. Default contact_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Tenant Id
configurationParameters.description: Xero organisation tenant id. Sent as Xero-Tenant-Id on every Accounting API call.
